stemMd: A club sold 20 tickets on Monday at $5 each and 30 tickets on Tuesday at $7 each. What was the mean price per ticket sold across both days?
explanationMd: Total revenue is 20 times 5 plus 30 times 7=310 dollars. Divide by the total 50 tickets to obtain the weighted mean price 6.20 dollars.

distractorRationale.a: This gives equal weight to days instead of individual tickets.
distractorRationale.d: This ignores the lower-priced Monday tickets.
distractorRationale.c: This is not the revenue-weighted total divided by ticket count.
